info.name: Hospital CRM + ERP API
info.description: Full CRUD collection generated from the live Django URL resolver (apps/*/urls.py) — one folder per module, one sub-folder per resource, standard List/Create/Retrieve/Update/Partial Update/Delete requests plus each ViewSet's custom actions. Run '00. Auth > Login' first to populate {{access_token}}. Kept in step with the API by docs/postman/sync_collection.py (adds new routes, fixes/prunes dead ones). Patient-portal requests use 'Authorization: Portal {{portal_token}}' — run '39. Patient Portal > Post Verify OTP' to set it; public TV-board and teleconsult-join requests need no login.

request.description:
ECDH key-exchange handshake for application-layer payload encryption (Layer 2).

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Client generates an ephemeral P-256 key pair.
2. Client posts its public key here.
3. Server returns its public key + a session_id.
4. Both sides independently derive the same AES-256 shared key -- it is NEVER transmitted.
5. All subsequent API requests send {"enc":"gcm2$..."} and responses arrive the same way.

POSTMAN NOTE:
This endpoint only does something when PAYLOAD_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=True on the server.
For dev/Postman testing, leave PAYLOAD_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=False -- plain JSON works as normal.

---
**Who can use this** (checked against the demo hospital's role templates):

✅ Hospital Owner / Admin, Front Desk Officer, Front Office, Doctor, Surgeon, Anaesthetist, Nurse, OT Manager, Lab Technician, Radiology Technician, Pharmacist, Billing Executive, Finance Manager, HR Manager, Medical Records Officer, CRM Manager, Patient Relations Executive, Call Centre Executive, Telephony Operator, Marketing Manager

exec: // Layer 2: Application Payload Encryption (ECDH + AES-256-GCM / gcm2$)
//   Frontend auto-does ECDH handshake on page load.
//   All request/response bodies are encrypted blobs in DevTools.
//   Middleware is a complete no-op. Use plain JSON as normal.
// Sensitive fields (phone, national_id_number, clinical notes) are
// stored encrypted in PostgreSQL. API decrypts on read -- always send
// Phone search: ?phone=9876543210 (plaintext -- server handles blind index)
// Run '00. Auth > Login' first -- sets {{access_token}} automatically.
// Access tokens expire in 1h; use 'Refresh access token' to re-auth.
// Tenant — which hospital a request is for
// Staff requests resolve the hospital from the logged-in user. Public and
// patient-portal requests need it from the subdomain or X-Tenant: set
